description: Job Butler's Approval hook: blocks outward tools and Checkpoint writes that no Approval or standing grant covers.

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/core/src/cli.ts" hook pre-tool-use || { echo "Job Butler's Approval hook couldn't run, so it blocked this tool call. Check that Node 22.18 or later is installed." >&2; exit 2; }
